answer: Every agent identity must lock a bond before it may act. A clone farm can copy names cheaply, but copying the bond means sinking real capital into each fake. Detection links clones through shared funding, timing, or an identical vine of referrals, and a marble of evidence is enough to trigger slashing, which seizes the locked bonds. The economic river then runs against the attacker: every additional Sybil costs more than it can extract, so fabrication stops paying.
